objections.claim: The release boundary remains fail-open for the allowlisted historical tags. At fc0fa05, v0.1.0/v0.2.0 exist without bound releases; the candidate exempts them from the tag↔release bijection while granting the controller and publisher GitHub Apps `contents:write`, which authorizes release creation. Either App can publish the first release against an existing historical tag without creating or modifying a tag ref, so the all-tags ruleset does not intervene; immutable releases only protect it after publication, and the integrity sweep detects the unauthorized public release after exposure. The EXISTING-TAG regression covers only an already-bound tag whose release slot is occupied, not these deliberately unbound historical tags. Thus blocker 6 and the fail-closed publication requirement remain unresolved.
